acquisition method: The top 20 most intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell
alkylation reagent: Carbamidomethyl (C) as static modification in the Mascot searches for phosphopeptides
cleavage agent: Two missed cleavage on trypsin was allowed
collision energy: The top 20 most intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell at normalized collision energy of 27%
enrichment method: then incubated with 4 mg TiO2 beads (GL sciences, Torrance, CA, USA) for three times
fragmentation method: The top 20 most intense precursor ions were selected for fragmentation in the HCD cell
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus via a nano-electrospray ion source
ionization type: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus via a nano-electrospray ion source
labeling: By employing a label-free, MS (Mass Spectrometry)-based phosphoproteomic approach
